roadmap.title: Opening and story
roadmap.description: Walk during Mission 1's opening, then play the story missions in order; replay any mission from Mission Select.

roadmap.title: Early skills and combat
roadmap.description: Buy early upgrades, set your Echo colour, keep full Focus, and clear the Fly Trap and gridNode challenges.

roadmap.title: Combos, deliveries and side content
roadmap.description: Do combo spots, deliveries, billboards, terminals, Dashes, and the district side missions as areas open.

roadmap.title: Hubs, side-mission sets and skills
roadmap.description: Destroy all Security Hubs, finish every side mission, and buy the remaining upgrades.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and 3-star Dashes
roadmap.description: After the ending, use the map to clear gridLeaks and remaining collectibles, then 3-star every Dash.

roadmap.title: Online
roadmap.description: Online features need a revived server since EA's shutdown.

guide.context: Achievements only unlock while the game is connected to a working server. EA's servers closed in December 2023, so a community server is needed to unlock anything.

achievements.description: Complete all of Plastic's missions
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Complete all of Plastic's missions.

guide.context: Plastic's missions unlock one at a time as you advance the story.

steps.text: Meet Plastic during @loc{Savant Extraordinaire}.
Run each timed red gridLeak mission she gives as the story goes on: Metanet, Ear to the Ground, Hand on the Pulse and Full Coverage.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions in Downtown
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Complete all side missions in the Downtown district.

steps.text: Finish the five Downtown side missions on the map: Interrupted Flight (Erato), Interrupted Flight (Thalia), Illegal Intrusion, Drone Development and Full Coverage.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions in Anchor
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Complete all side missions in the Anchor district.

steps.text: Finish the three Anchor side missions: Gridnode Run, Metanet and Caught in the Net.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions in Rezoning
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Complete all side missions in the Rezoning district.

steps.text: Finish the Rezoning side missions Ear to the Ground and Top of the World.
The Rezoning gridNode run does not count.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions in The View
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Finish every side mission in the View district.

steps.text: Finish the View side missions Hand on the Pulse and Escape Routes.
The View gridNode run does not count.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions
achievements.sortReason: Side missions open as districts unlock.
achievements.summary: Complete all 12 counted side missions.

guide.context: The Downtown, Rezoning and View gridNode runs do not count. The Anchor gridNode run does.

steps.text: Finish all 12 counted side missions: Interrupted Flight (Erato), Interrupted Flight (Thalia), Illegal Intrusion, Drone Development, Gridnode Run (Anchor), Metanet, Caught in the Net, Top of the World, Ear to the Ground, Hand on the Pulse, Full Coverage and Escape Routes.

achievements.description: Purchase Faith's second upgrade
achievements.sortReason: Spend skill points after early missions.
achievements.summary: Buy Faith's second upgrade in the Progression menu.

steps.text: Open the Progression menu and buy two upgrades.

achievements.description: Purchase half of Faith's upgrades
achievements.sortReason: Spend skill points through the story.
achievements.summary: Buy half of all upgrades in the Progression menu.

steps.text: Keep buying upgrades in the Progression menu until half are owned.

achievements.description: Purchase all of Faith's upgrades
achievements.sortReason: Needs the late skills; most points come from finishing.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade in the Progression menu.

steps.text: Keep buying upgrades in the Progression menu until every upgrade is owned.

achievements.description: Reach full focus and keep it going
achievements.sortReason: Run laps once Skill Roll is unlocked.
achievements.summary: Keep the Focus bar full for about two minutes.

guide.context: Climbing, tight turns, long falls and missed Skill Rolls break the flow. With the Quickturn upgrade you can instead run end to end and press Q to turn each time, which keeps Focus full.

steps.text: After the first story mission, go to a flat open area, such as the outer ring of the safehouse called @loc{The Lair}.
Fill the Focus bar by running, then run wide laps without climbing, sharp turns or long falls; land with a Skill Roll.
Keep the bar full for about two minutes.

achievements.description: Springboard, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump, Coil, Skill Roll
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Springboard, then wallclimb, then turn, then jump, then coil, then skill roll.

guide.context: Needs the Skill Roll, Coil and Quickturn upgrades.

steps.text: Outside the Triumvirate Drive safehouse, springboard off the safety railing next to the large black wall, wallclimb, quickturn, jump, Coil, then Skill Roll on landing.

achievements.description: Shift, Wallrun, Jump, Coil, Skill Roll, Shift
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Shift, then wallrun, then jump, then coil, then skill roll, then shift.

guide.context: Needs the Skill Roll and Coil upgrades.

steps.text: Near @loc{The Lair} in Triumvirate Drive, start standing next to a wall: Shift, Wallrun, Jump off, Coil, Skill Roll on landing, then Shift.

achievements.description: Wallrun, Turn, Jump, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Wallrun, then turn, then jump, then wallclimb, then turn, then jump, then wallclimb, then turn, then jump.

steps.text: Go to the narrow hallway one turn from the skybridge below Plastic's safehouse and wallrun, turn, jump, then wallclimb, turn, jump twice more.

achievements.description: Shift, Springboard, Wallrun, Swing Pipe, Skill Roll
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Shift, then springboard, then wallrun, then swing pipe, then skill roll.

steps.text: Near @loc{The Lair} in Triumvirate Drive, do Shift and Springboard, then Wallrun, Swing Pipe and finish with Skill Roll.

achievements.description: Springboard, Swingbar, Jump, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump, Coil
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Springboard, then swingbar, then jump, then wallclimb, then turn, then jump, then coil.

guide.context: Needs the Quickturn and Coil upgrades.

steps.text: In @loc{Encroachment}, just before you destroy the first sentry turret, do Springboard and Swingbar, then Jump, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump and Coil.

achievements.description: Vault, Slide, Jump, Wallclimb, Turn, Jump, Wallrun, Turn, Jump, Skill Roll
achievements.summary: Do these moves in order without a break: Vault, then slide, then jump, then wallclimb, then turn, then jump, then wallrun, then turn, then jump, then skill roll.

guide.context: Needs the Quickturn and Skill Roll upgrades.

steps.text: Outside the safehouse in Centurian Yards, run a few metres after the vault before sliding if needed, then finish the chain with Skill Roll on landing.

achievements.description: Reach full focus and take out 10 enemies before it runs out
achievements.summary: Fill the Focus bar and defeat 10 enemies before it runs out.

guide.context: A second spot is the corridor near the top of @loc{The Shard}, which holds about 15 mostly riflemen.

steps.text: In @loc{Fly Trap}, after you reach the safehouse, fill your Focus bar by running and jumping.
Fight the guards, stunning then striking; hits you take lower Focus and hits you land raise it.
Restart from the checkpoint if Focus empties early.

achievements.description: Perform a highground attack as a finishing move
achievements.summary: Finish an enemy with a high-ground attack.

steps.text: In @loc{Fly Trap}, defeat every KrugerSec guard but one.
Climb above the last guard, jump down onto them and keep attacking until they fall.

achievements.description: Deliver any fragile package without any damage to it
achievements.sortReason: Fragile deliveries open in free roam.
achievements.summary: Deliver a fragile package without damaging it.

guide.context: The timer is the main constraint.

steps.text: Start a Fragile Delivery on the map and reach the drop-off before the timer ends.

achievements.description: Shut down any gridNode without notifying KrugerSec of your presence
achievements.summary: Shut down a gridNode without KrugerSec noticing you.

steps.text: Do the first gridNode Run, which is required for the story.
Stop the fan, climb the servers and cross the lasers without touching any blue laser; do not grab a ledge near one.
Kick the vent cover off at the end to shut down the node.
If a laser trips, reload the last checkpoint.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Dashes in the main game
achievements.sortReason: Dashes unlock as the story opens areas.
achievements.summary: Finish 10 Dashes from the main game.

steps.text: Start Dashes from the map as they open and finish 10; time does not matter.

achievements.description: Get a 3-star rating on all Dashes in the main game
achievements.summary: Earn 3 stars on all 22 Dashes in the main game.

steps.text: Finish the story, then buy Climb Efficiency, Extended Slide and Coil and the Magrope.
Retry each Dash: Shift after each move, Skill Roll on long falls, Coil after every jump and avoid ladders and pipes.
If lost, run the Dash once to see the finish, then restart, place a map marker at the finish and follow Pulse.

achievements.description: Deliver 10 packages
achievements.summary: Deliver 10 different packages.

steps.text: Finish 10 different delivery jobs from the map; repeating one job does not count.

achievements.description: Complete 15 billboard hacks and interventions
achievements.summary: Complete 15 billboard hacks and Interventions combined.

steps.text: Hack the billboards on the map as the story opens them (about 12).
Start an Intervention when KrugerSec harass a runner; defeat all of them. They appear at set spots depending on the time of day.
Keep going until the combined total reaches 15.

achievements.description: Remove 10 electronic parts from Conglomerate terminals
achievements.sortReason: Terminals are everywhere in the city.
achievements.summary: Take electronic parts from 10 Conglomerate terminals.

steps.text: Walk up to any Conglomerate terminal and press E; repeat at 10 terminals.

collectibles.name: Mission 6 bag 2

collectibles.name: Mission 10 bag 2
collectibles.method: Turn right, run along the white wall, then quickturn and jump up to the lift rooftop.

collectibles.name: Mission 11 bag 1

collectibles.name: Mission 11 bag 2
collectibles.method: Go to the courier symbol, vault the railing and wallrun to the far catwalk.

collectibles.name: Mission 12 bag 1

collectibles.name: Mission 12 bag 2

collectibles.method: Springboard across the balconies, break through the door by the courier symbol.

collectibles.name: Mission 13 bag 2
collectibles.method: Wallclimb, quickturn to the black fixtures, then hop to the alcove.

collectibles.name: Mission 15 bag 1
collectibles.method: Turn round after the crash and drop to the outside platform.

collectibles.name: Mission 15 bag 2

collectibles.name: Centurian Yards bag
collectibles.location: Yellow scaffolding on the tall building facing Zephyr
collectibles.method: Wallclimb, quickturn, jump, then wallrun and jump to the top.

achievements.description: Collect every gridLeak in Glass
achievements.sortReason: Map shows them after the ending.
achievements.summary: Collect all 324 gridLeaks in Glass.

guide.context: The map shows gridLeaks after the ending; no other collectible is revealed this way.

steps.text: Pick up gridLeaks as you roam; they are yellow holograms.
Finish the story to unlock the skill that shows every remaining gridLeak on the map, then clear them.

achievements.description: Complete a user created Time Trial
achievements.summary: Complete a Time Trial created by a player.

guide.context: This needs a server that supports user-made content. Use a community server that supports user content, such as BeatLink.

steps.text: Press U to open the run editor, place a start and two or three checkpoints, and save it.
Run your own Time Trial.

achievements.description: Get yourself to a user created Beat L.E.
achievements.summary: Reach a Beacon placed by a player.

guide.context: This needs a server that supports user-made content. Use a community server that supports user content, such as BeatLink.

steps.text: Find a player-made Beacon on the map and activate it.

achievements.description: Customize your Echo
achievements.sortReason: Change Echo colour in the map menu.
achievements.summary: Change your Echo colour.

guide.context: You can switch back to the default afterward.

steps.text: Open the map, go to Progression, press Your Echo at the bottom left and pick any colour other than the default.

achievements.description: A good Cascadian follows the rules
achievements.sortReason: Opening walk; replay Mission 1 if missed.
achievements.summary: Walk without running during the opening of the game.

guide.context: Running fails it. Restart from the checkpoint or replay Mission 1 from Mission Select.

steps.text: After Faith is released in Mission 1, walk (hold the walk key) until the first stairs down to the underpass.
